chapter: Georgie Auld, Hawkins and Los Angeles
title: The Finale Club band with Bird
summary: McGhee's eight-piece band with four saxes including Bird, Sonny Criss and Teddy Edwards, played the Finale Club with little money.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Well, at that time was he working with you? Were the two of you working in a club?
Well, not when we did the date.
We did go into a place called the FInale Club, and I had an eight-piece band there and four saxes and four rhythm.

Sonny Criss, Teddy Edwards, Gene Montgomery and Bird. So the bad was beautiful, but we weren't making any money. I mean, people would enjoy it or be loaded, but people would come into the joint that was in there before we'd come in, and we couldn't chase them out and say, "You've got to come back and pay admission." So we played there and it turned out pretty nice. But we wasn't making a lot of money.
